display.purpose: Page-level hero headlines only, one per page.

shadows.name: lightbox-overlay
shadows.purpose: Full-bleed image lightbox floating over the page. The only sanctioned shadow use.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Reserved for the single most important action per page (contact CTA).
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: oklch(0.56 0.19 25); color: oklch(0.98 0 0); padding: 14px 32px; border-radius: 2px; border: none; font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 600; font-size: 0.9375rem; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.4s cubic-bezier(0.25, 1, 0.5, 1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: oklch(0.42 0.18 25); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid oklch(0.72 0.09 230); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { background: transparent; color: oklch(0.95 0 0); padding: 14px 32px; border-radius: 2px; border: 1px solid oklch(0.24 0 0); font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 600; font-size: 0.9375rem; cursor: pointer; transition: border-color 0.4s cubic-bezier(0.25, 1, 0.5, 1); } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { border-color: oklch(0.62 0 0); } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid oklch(0.72 0.09 230); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Media Item Card
components.description: Signature component: a single portfolio photo/video with a below-image caption. No border, no shadow, no overlay.
components.css: .ds-media-card { margin: 0; } .ds-media-card-image { aspect-ratio: 4/5; background: oklch(0.15 0 0); border-radius: 2px; transition: transform 0.4s cubic-bezier(0.25, 1, 0.5, 1); } .ds-media-card:hover .ds-media-card-image { transform: scale(1.02); } .ds-media-card-caption { margin-top: 12px; font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 600; font-size: 1.125rem; color: oklch(0.95 0 0); }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Contact form field: underline-only, no boxed background.
components.css: .ds-field { display: block; } .ds-field-label { display: block; font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.8125rem; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.02em; color: oklch(0.62 0 0); margin-bottom: 6px; } .ds-field-input { width: 100%; background: transparent; border: none; border-bottom: 1px solid oklch(0.24 0 0); color: oklch(0.95 0 0); font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 1rem; padding: 8px 0; } .ds-field-input:focus { outline: none; border-bottom-color: oklch(0.72 0.09 230); }

components.name: Primary Nav
components.description: Header navigation. Active link gets a tally-red underline.
components.html: PortfolioServicesAbout
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; gap: 32px; } .ds-nav-link { font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.9375rem; color: oklch(0.95 0 0); text-decoration: none; padding-bottom: 4px; border-bottom: 2px solid transparent; } .ds-nav-link-active { border-bottom-color: oklch(0.56 0.19 25); }

narrative.overview: HallWay Creative is a private screening room, not a storefront. The room is dark by default — near-black walls, no glare — because that's the condition under which photography and film actually read as intentional rather than decorative. Into that dark room, exactly one signal is allowed to be loud: the tally light, the red indicator that lights up on a video camera the instant it starts recording. Everywhere else, the interface stays quiet, deferential, out of the way, so the work fills the frame. This system explicitly rejects the photographer-template playbook: no stock-photo hero carousels, no "trusted by" logo rows, no SaaS hero-metric stat blocks, no tiny uppercase eyebrows stamped above every section, no gradient text, no side-stripe accent borders, no identical icon-card grids. Confidence here comes from restraint, not volume. Light mode exists as a fully realized second surface — daylight through the same screening room, same identity, same tally-light red — for contexts where dark isn't wanted. It is not a stripped-down fallback; every rule applies to both.
keyCharacteristics: Near-black resting state; pure white as the fully-realized light counterpart.
One saturated accent (the tally-light red), used on under ~10% of any given screen.
Editorial serif display type (Fraunces) carries all the personality; body/UI type (Inter) stays quiet.
Flat by default. Depth comes from tonal layering, not drop shadows.

rules.name: The One Light Rule
rules.body: Tally-Light Red appears in at most one place per screen at rest (a CTA, an active tab). If a second red shows up, one of the two is wrong.

rules.name: The No-Tint Rule
rules.body: Neutrals stay chroma-0 (true black/white/grey) in both themes. Warmth and mood come from the red and the serif display type, never from tinting the background.

rules.name: The Title-Card Rule
rules.body: Fraunces is reserved for Display and Headline roles only. It never appears in body copy, buttons, or UI chrome.

rules.name: The Sentence-Case Rule
rules.body: No uppercase tracked labels/eyebrows anywhere in the system. Labels use sentence case with light positive tracking.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat at rest. A shadow appears only when something is genuinely floating above the page (a lightbox, an open mobile menu) — never as decoration on a static card.

dos: Do let the photograph be the largest, highest-contrast element on every screen it appears on.
Do reserve Tally-Light Red for exactly one purpose per screen.
Do use Fraunces only for Display and Headline roles; everything else is Inter.
Do build both themes (dark default, light available) to the same standard.
Do support prefers-reduced-motion with an instant/crossfade fallback on every reveal.
donts: Don't add a stock-photo hero carousel, testimonial carousel, or 'trusted by' logo row.
Don't use SaaS hero-metric stat blocks or feature-grid cards repeated identically.
Don't add a tiny uppercase tracked eyebrow above sections.
Don't use gradient text or background-clip: text for emphasis.
Don't use border-left/border-right as a colored accent stripe.
Don't use numbered 01/02/03 markers as decorative scaffolding.
Don't tint the neutral background toward cream, navy, or any hue 'for warmth'.
Don't drop a shadow on a static card.
